column1: # Host files the running MAG stack depends on, and where they come from.
# Checked by ops/inventory/drift-check.sh (read-only; never prints contents).
#   copy       installed bytes must equal the repo file
#   render     like copy after replacing @ROOT@ with the checkout path
#   generated  written by the named installer from repo templates; must exist
#   secret     credential/state outside Git; must exist, restored from backup
# --- NUMA model servers (Ornith on both nodes, :8191 NUMA0, :8192 NUMA1)
# --- audit gateway :8080 (C++ binary under /opt/mag-audit, built from this repo)
